en.s: The Battle of Clontarf (Irish: Cath Chluain Tarbh) was a battle that took place on 23 April 1014 at Clontarf, near Dublin, on the east coast of Ireland. It pitted the forces of Brian Boru, high king of Ireland, against a Norse-Irish alliance comprising the forces of Sigtrygg Silkbeard, king of Dublin, Máel Mórda mac Murchada, king of Leinster, and a Viking contingent led by Sigurd of Orkney and Brodir of Mann. It lasted from sunrise to sunset, and ended in a rout of the Viking and Leinster forces. It is estimated that between 7,000 and 10,000 men were killed.

zh.s: 克朗塔夫战役（爱尔兰语：Cath Chluain Tarbh）于1014年4月23日在爱尔兰都柏林附近的克朗塔夫发生。爱尔兰至高王布赖恩·博鲁率军对阵北欧—爱尔兰联军，联军成员包括都柏林国王西特里克·丝胡须、伦斯特国王马埃尔·莫尔达·麦克·穆尔卡达的部队，以及由奥克尼的西居尔和马恩岛的布罗迪尔率领的维京人。战斗从日出持续到日落，最终维京人和伦斯特军队溃败。据估计，双方共有7000至10000人死亡。

en.t: The first knights of the Order of the Garter, an order of chivalry founded by King Edward III of England, were appointed
en.s: The Most Noble Order of the Garter is an order of chivalry founded by King Edward III in 1348. The most senior order of knighthood in the British honours system, it is outranked in precedence only by the decorations of the Victoria Cross and the George Cross. The Order of the Garter is dedicated to the image and arms of Saint George, England's patron saint.

zh.t: 加特勋章首批骑士获任命
zh.s: 嘉德勋章是英王爱德华三世于1348年创立的骑士勋章，也是英国荣誉制度中级别最高的骑士勋章，地位仅次于维多利亚十字勋章和乔治十字勋章。该勋章以英格兰守护圣人圣乔治的形象和纹章为标志。

en.t: Portuguese explorer Pedro Alvarez Cabral reaches new coastline (Brazil)
en.s: Pedro Álvares Cabral (European Portuguese: [ˈpeðɾu ˈalvɐɾɨʃ kɐˈβɾal], Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈpedɾu ˈawvɐɾɨʃ, ˈawvɐɾɨs kɐˈbɾal]; born Pedro Álvares de Gouveia; c. 1467 or 1468 – c. 1520) was a Portuguese nobleman, colonizer, military commander, navigator and explorer regarded as the European discoverer of Brazil. He was the first human in history to ever be on four continents, uniting all of them in his famous voyage of 1500, where he also conducted the first substantial exploration of the northeast coast of South America and claimed it for Portugal.

zh.t: 葡萄牙探险家佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔抵达一段新海岸（巴西）
zh.s: 佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔（欧洲葡萄牙语：[ˈpeðɾu ˈalvɐɾɨʃ kɐˈβɾal]；巴西葡萄牙语：[ˈpedɾu ˈawvɐɾɨʃ, ˈawvɐɾɨs kɐˈbɾal]；本名佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·古韦亚；约1467或1468年—约1520年）是葡萄牙贵族、殖民者、军事指挥官、航海家和探险家，被视为欧洲发现巴西的人。他是历史上首位踏足四大洲的人；在1500年的著名航行中，他将四大洲联系起来，还首次深入探索南美洲东北海岸，并宣称该地归葡萄牙所有。

en.s: The Raid of Marrakesh took place on April 23 1515, when the Portuguese governor of Safi Nuno Fernandes de Ataíde led a raid that penetrated as far as Marrakesh in hopes of forcing its Hintata ruler to accept Portuguese suzerainty. The attack, however, failed. It is considered the most daring exploit in the career of Ataíde and the high point of Portuguese expansion in Morocco.

zh.s: 1515年4月23日，葡萄牙萨菲总督努诺·费尔南德斯·德·阿泰德率军突袭，深入马拉喀什，希望迫使当地欣塔塔统治者接受葡萄牙宗主权，但行动失败。这被认为是阿泰德生涯中最大胆的行动，也是葡萄牙在摩洛哥扩张的顶峰。

en.s: The Battle of Villalar was a battle in the Revolt of the Comuneros fought on April 23, 1521 near the town of Villalar in Valladolid province, Spain. The royalist supporters of King Charles I won a crushing victory over the comuneros rebels. Three of the most important rebel leaders were captured, Juan de Padilla, Juan Bravo, and Francisco Maldonado.

zh.s: 比利亚拉尔战役是公社起义中的一场战斗，于1521年4月23日在西班牙巴利亚多利德省比利亚拉尔镇附近发生。查理一世的保王派军队大获全胜，三名重要的起义领袖胡安·德·帕迪利亚、胡安·布拉沃和弗朗西斯科·马尔多纳多被俘。

en.s: The 1578 siege of Otate (御館の乱, Otate no ran) took place following the sudden death of Uesugi Kenshin. Kenshin had requested that the inheritance be split between his nephew, Uesugi Kagekatsu, and his adopted son Uesugi Kagetora. This conflict happened because of neither heirs being born with the Uesugi name. Kagekatsu was the biological son of Nagao Masakage and Kagetora was biological son of Hojo Ujiyasu. Before the situation could escalate into an armed conflict, Takeda Katsuyori acted as the mediator between those two. Therefore, eventually the Uesugi was divided for a military conflict. The Takeda supported Kagekatsu and the Hojo supported Kagetora. Thus, on April 23, 1578— the 17th day of the 3rd month of Tensho 6 on the Japanese lunar calendar— Uesugi Kagekatsu led a force from his castle at Kasugayama to besiege Otate castle .

zh.s: 1578年，上杉谦信突然去世后爆发御馆之乱。谦信曾要求将家业分给侄子上杉景胜和养子上杉景虎。两人都不是以“上杉”为姓氏出生的，这也成为冲突的原因之一。景胜是长尾政景的亲生儿子，景虎则是北条氏康的亲生儿子。冲突演变成武装对抗前，武田胜赖曾出面调停。最终上杉家族分裂，各方准备交战：武田支持景胜，北条支持景虎。1578年4月23日，即日本旧历天正六年三月十七日，上杉景胜率军从春日山城出发，围攻御馆城。

en.s: The Siege of Eindhoven, also known as the Capture of Eindhoven of 1583, took place between February 7 and April 23, 1583, at Eindhoven, Duchy of Brabant, Spanish Netherlands (present-day North Brabant, the Netherlands) during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). On February 7, 1583, a Spanish force sent by Don Alexander Farnese (Spanish: Alejandro Farnesio), Governor-General of the Spanish Netherlands, commanded by Karl von Mansfeld and Claude de Berlaymont laid siege to Eindhoven, an important and strategic city of Brabant held by Dutch, Scottish and French soldiers under the States' commander Hendrik van Bonnivet.

zh.s: 埃因霍温围城战又称1583年埃因霍温陷落，发生于1583年2月7日至4月23日，地点在八十年战争和英西战争期间的布拉班特公国埃因霍温，当时该地属于西属尼德兰，今为荷兰北布拉班特省的一部分。1583年2月7日，西属尼德兰总督亚历山大·法尔内塞派卡尔·冯·曼斯费尔德和克洛德·德·贝尔莱蒙率军围攻埃因霍温。这座重要的战略城市由荷兰、苏格兰和法国士兵驻守，守军由联省议会将领亨德里克·范·博尼维指挥。

en.t: The first public school in the United States, the Boston Latin School, is founded
en.s: The Boston Latin School is a magnet Latin grammar state school in Boston, Massachusetts. It has been in continuous operation since it was established on April 23, 1635, and is one of the oldest existing schools in the United States, the other being Collegiate School in New York City.

zh.t: 美国首所公立学校波士顿拉丁学校创立
zh.s: 波士顿拉丁学校是美国马萨诸塞州波士顿的一所公立精英拉丁文法学校。该校自1635年4月23日创立以来一直持续办学，是美国历史最悠久的现存学校之一；另一所是纽约的协和学院。

en.s: The Siege of Santo Domingo of 1655, was fought between April 23, 1655 to April 30, 1655 at the Spanish Colony of Santo Domingo. A force of 2,400 Spanish troops led by Governor Don Bernardino Meneses y Bracamonte, Count of Peñalba, successfully resisted a force of 13,120 troops and 34 ships of the English Commonwealth Navy led by Admiral Sir William Penn. The English force landed some thirty miles from their objective, the city of Santo Domingo. After a march of four days through heavy rough country with little water, the column was routed in an ambush by a few hundred vaqueros.

zh.s: 1655年4月23日至30日，英国英联邦海军围攻西班牙殖民地圣多明各。唐·贝尔纳迪诺·梅内塞斯·布拉卡蒙特伯爵、佩尼亚尔瓦伯爵率领2400名西班牙士兵，成功抵御了威廉·佩恩爵士海军上将率领的英国军队。英军有13120名士兵和34艘舰船。英军在距离目标圣多明各市约30英里处登陆，随后在缺水、崎岖的地形中行军四天，最终遭数百名牛仔伏击而溃败。

en.s: The Treaty or Peace of Oliva (Polish: Pokój Oliwski; Swedish: Freden i Oliva; German: Vertrag von Oliva) was one of the peace treaties ending the Second Northern War (1655–1660). It was signed on 3 May [O.S. 23 April] 1660. The Treaty of Oliva, the Treaty of Copenhagen in the same year, and the Treaty of Cardis in the following year marked the high point of the Swedish Empire.
en.n: Treaty of Oliva is established between Sweden and Poland.

zh.s: 奥利瓦条约（波兰语：Pokój Oliwski；瑞典语：Freden i Oliva；德语：Vertrag von Oliva）是结束第二次北方战争（1655—1660年）的和平条约之一。条约于1660年5月3日签署（儒略历4月23日）。同年签署的奥利瓦条约和哥本哈根条约，以及次年签署的卡尔迪斯条约，标志着瑞典帝国势力达到顶峰。
zh.n: 瑞典与波兰签订奥利瓦条约。

en.s: The Northern War of 1655–1660 was fought between the Swedish Empire and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, with participation at different times by Russia, Brandenburg-Prussia, the Habsburg monarchy, and Denmark–Norway. It ended with the treaties of Copenhagen and Oliva in 1660. In 1655, Charles X took advantage of the Russo-Polish War (1654–67) to over-run western Poland. The Grand Duchy of Lithuania was annexed by Sweden, and John II Casimir Vasa took refuge in Vienna.

zh.s: 1655至1660年的北方战争由瑞典帝国和波兰—立陶宛联邦交战，俄罗斯、勃兰登堡—普鲁士、哈布斯堡君主国和丹麦—挪威在不同时期也参与其中。战争于1660年以哥本哈根条约和奥利瓦条约结束。1655年，瑞典国王卡尔十世利用俄波战争（1654—1667年）入侵波兰西部。瑞典随后吞并立陶宛大公国，约翰二世·卡齐米日·瓦萨则逃往维也纳避难。

en.t: King Charles II of England, Scotland and Ireland is crowned in Westminster Abbey
en.s: Charles II (29 May 1630 – 6 February 1685) was King of Scotland from 1649 until 1651 and King of England, Scotland, and Ireland from the 1660 Restoration of the monarchy until his death in 1685. Charles II was the eldest surviving child of Charles I of England, Scotland and Ireland and Henrietta Maria of France.

zh.t: 查理二世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕
zh.s: 1661年4月23日，查理二世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕。他生于1630年、逝于1685年，是查理一世与法国的亨利埃塔·玛丽亚尚存子女中的长子；此前曾于1649年至1651年任苏格兰国王，自1660年王政复辟起统治英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰，直至去世。

en.s: The Battle of Sokolka took place on April 23, 1709, near the town of Poltava, Ukraine, during the ninth year of the Great Northern War. The Swedish army of close to 3,000 cavalry under the command of Carl Gustaf Kruse and 3,500 Cossacks of Kost Gordiyenko and Ivan Mazepa launched a surprise attack on a Russian camp of about 3,000 cavalrymen and 2,000 Cossacks under Karl Evald von Rönne. Although encamped and taken by surprise, the Russians were immediately alerted and successfully counterattacked, cutting their way through the enemy forces, and eventually escaped, having captured 4 guns left behind by the fleeing Zaporozhian Cossacks and a number of prisoners.

zh.s: 索科尔卡战役于1709年4月23日在乌克兰波尔塔瓦附近爆发，当时大北方战争已进入第九年。卡尔·古斯塔夫·克鲁塞率领近3000名瑞典骑兵，与科斯特·戈尔迪延科和伊万·马泽帕率领的3500名哥萨克，突袭卡尔·埃瓦尔德·冯·雷恩指挥的俄军营地。俄军约有3000名骑兵和2000名哥萨克。尽管俄军驻营中并遭到突袭，他们很快就得到警报并成功反击，杀出重围后撤离；他们还缴获了逃跑的扎波罗热哥萨克留下的4门火炮和一些俘虏。

en.t: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata Du Hirte Israel, höre, BWV 104, illustrating the topic of the Good Shepherd in pastoral music
en.s: Du Hirte Israel, höre (You Shepherd of Israel, hear), BWV 104, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach for the second Sunday after Easter. Bach composed the work as part of his first cantata cycle for Leipzig and first performed it on 23 April 1724. The topic of the cantata, based on the prescribed reading from the Gospel of John, is Jesus as the Good Shepherd.

zh.t: 巴赫首次指挥清唱剧《以色列的牧者，请听》
zh.s: 《以色列的牧者，请听》（德语：Du Hirte Israel, höre，BWV 104）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫为复活节后第二个星期日创作的一部教会清唱剧。巴赫在莱比锡创作这部作品，将其纳入第一套清唱剧组曲，并于1724年4月23日首次演出。作品根据《约翰福音》的指定经文，描绘耶稣为好牧人。

en.s: The action of 23 April 1794 took place between a British squadron of five frigates under the command of Sir John Borlase Warren and three frigates and a corvette under the command of Chef d'escadre Georges Desgarceaux during the War of the First Coalition. Three of the French ships were captured.

zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争期间，约翰·博拉斯·沃伦爵士率领的英国分舰队与乔治·德加尔索上校率领的法国舰队于1794年4月23日交战。英方有5艘护卫舰，法方有3艘护卫舰和1艘轻型护卫舰。法国有3艘船被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Ratisbon, also called the Battle of Regensburg, was a meeting engagement fought on 23 April 1809, during the Napoleonic Wars, between the army of the French Empire, led by Napoleon I, and that of the Austrian Empire, led by Archduke Charles. Scene of the last engagement of the Bavaria phase of the campaign of 1809, the brief defense of the city and installation of a pontoon bridge to the east enabled the retreating Austrian army to escape into Bohemia.

zh.s: 拉蒂斯邦战役又称雷根斯堡战役，于1809年4月23日在拿破仑战争期间爆发，是一场遭遇战。法国帝国军由拿破仑一世率领，奥地利帝国军由奥地利大公查理率领。这是1809年战役在巴伐利亚阶段的最后一场交战。奥军短暂守城，法军则在城东架设浮桥，使撤退中的奥军得以逃往波希米亚。

en.s: The Battle of Cesenatico was a minor battle in the Neapolitan War that took place on 23 April 1815 in the town of Cesenatico on Adriatic coast. The main Neapolitan army, commanded by their king, Joachim Murat, was retreating to their original headquarters in Ancona following a string a defeats in northern Italy. The Neapolitans were being pursued by an Austrian corps under the command of Adam Albert von Neipperg. During the evening of the 23 April, while a Neapolitan garrison of 3,000 men were stationed in the town, a small force of 600 Austrians hussars and jägers rushed the single stone bridge into the town.

zh.s: 切塞纳蒂科战役是那不勒斯战争期间的一场小规模战斗，于1815年4月23日在亚得里亚海沿岸的切塞纳蒂科进行。那不勒斯主力军由国王约阿希姆·缪拉指挥，在意大利北部连遭败绩后正撤回安科纳原总部。亚当·阿尔贝特·冯·奈佩格率领的奥军一路追击。4月23日晚，城内驻有3000名那不勒斯守军，600名奥地利轻骑兵和猎兵突袭了通往城内的唯一一座石桥。

en.s: The Second Serbian Uprising was the second phase of the Serbian Revolution against the Ottoman Empire, which erupted shortly after the re-annexation of the country to the Ottoman Empire in 1813. The occupation was enforced following the defeat of the First Serbian Uprising (1804–1813), during which Serbia existed as a de facto independent state for over a decade. The second revolution ultimately resulted in Serbian semi-independence from the Ottoman Empire.
en.n: The Second Serbian Uprising: A second phase of the national revolution of the Serbs against the Ottoman Empire, erupts shortly after the annexation of the country to the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 第二次塞尔维亚起义是塞尔维亚革命的第二阶段，塞尔维亚于1813年重新并入奥斯曼帝国后不久，起义便爆发。此前，塞尔维亚在第一次塞尔维亚起义（1804—1813年）中曾事实独立十余年，之后遭到击败并被奥斯曼帝国重新占领。第二次革命最终使塞尔维亚从奥斯曼帝国获得半独立地位。
zh.n: 第二次塞尔维亚起义：塞尔维亚民族革命的第二阶段，在国家重新并入奥斯曼帝国后不久爆发。

en.s: The Battle of Mysunde (1848), or the First Battle of Mysunde took place in the First Schleswig War at Mysunde, Germany. The battle occurred April 23, 1848. The battle resulted in a Danish defeat.

en.s: The Battle of Schleswig occurred near the Danevirke on Easter morning, 23 April 1848 as the second battle of the First Schleswig War of 1848–1850. Prussia had just entered the war and had sent almost 12,000 troops to Schleswig-Holstein on command of the German Confederation. Counting reserves, General Wrangel commanded in total more than 18,000 men – almost three times the size of the Danish forces.

zh.s: 石勒苏益格战役于1848年复活节清晨（4月23日）在丹麦维京古防线附近爆发，是1848—1850年第一次石勒苏益格战争的第二场战斗。普鲁士刚刚参战，奉德意志邦联之命向石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因派出近12000名士兵。算上预备队，弗兰格尔将军共指挥18000多人，几乎是丹麦军队人数的三倍。

en.s: The Battle of Günterstal took place on 23 April 1848 during the Baden Revolution at Jägerbrunnen not far from the village of Günterstal. Here government troops stopped a vanguard of the militants who were advancing towards the city of Freiburg im Breisgau under Franz Sigel.

zh.s: 巴登革命期间，金特斯塔尔战役于1848年4月23日在耶格布龙嫩爆发，地点靠近金特斯塔尔村。政府军在此阻止了弗朗茨·西格尔率领的一支激进派先头部队继续向弗赖堡推进。

en.s: The Battle of Kolding was a battle during the First Schleswig War fought between a Prussian army under Eduard von Bonin and a Danish army under Frederik Rubeck Bülow in Kolding, Denmark on 23 April 1849. The Prussians were victorious and the Danish army was forced to retreat towards Vejle and Fredericia.

Bee attempt to block a numerically superior Union Army column that was commanded by Brigadier General William H. Emory during the Red River Campaign of the American Civil War. Confederate commander Major General Richard Taylor set a trap for the retreating army of Major General Nathaniel P.

en.s: The Battle of Munford took place in Munford, Alabama, on Sunday, April 23, 1865, during the raid through the state by 1,500 Union Army cavalrymen under General John T. Croxton, part of the force participating in Wilson's Raid. The Battle of Munford and a minor action at Hendersonville, North Carolina on the same day were the last battles of the American Civil War in the Eastern Theater of the American Civil War (east of the Mississippi River). The Confederate soldiers in the battle were described as convalescents, home guards, and pardoned deserters, while the Union cavalry was a veteran force armed with 7-shot Spencer repeating carbines.

zh.s: 美国内战期间，约翰·T·克罗克斯顿将军率领1500名联邦军骑兵突袭阿拉巴马州，1865年4月23日（星期日）在芒福德发生战斗。该部队是威尔逊突袭行动的一部分。同一天，北卡罗来纳州亨德森维尔也发生小规模交战；芒福德战役和亨德森维尔交战是密西西比河以东战区内战的最后两场战斗。南军参战者包括病愈中的士兵、地方守卫和获赦的逃兵，联邦军骑兵则是装备七发斯宾塞连发卡宾枪的老兵部队。

en.s: The Battle of Sappa Creek, or Massacre at Cheyenne Hole, was fought on April 23, 1875, between Company H of the Sixth United States Cavalry under the command of Second Lieutenant Austin Henely and a group of Cheyenne Indians led by Little Bull. The conflict took place in modern-day Rawlins County, Kansas, and was both the final and the deadliest battle in the Red River War.

zh.s: 萨帕溪战役又称夏延谷惨案，于1875年4月23日爆发。美国第六骑兵团H连在奥斯汀·亨利中尉指挥下，与小公牛率领的一支夏延人队伍交战。战场位于今天堪萨斯州罗林斯县。这是红河战争的最后一场战役，也是伤亡最惨重的一场。

en.s: The Taunton by-election of 1887 was held on 23 April 1887 in Taunton, Somerset, following the succession of the incumbent, Samuel Charles Allsopp, to the peerage upon the death of his father, becoming 2nd Baron Hindlip. One of Lord Hindlip's brothers, Alfred Percy Allsopp, stood for the Conservative Party, while James Harris Sanders was the candidate for the Liberal Party. Allsopp was elected, with a majority of 536 votes (23.1%). Although they had considered not contesting the election because the area was a Conservative stronghold, the Liberals decided to do so in order to generate a discussion on the issue of Home Rule for Ireland.

zh.s: 1887年4月23日，萨默塞特郡汤顿举行议会补选。时任议员塞缪尔·查尔斯·奥尔索普的父亲去世后，奥尔索普继承贵族头衔，成为第二代欣德利普男爵，因此触发补选。欣德利普勋爵的兄弟阿尔弗雷德·珀西·奥尔索普代表保守党参选，自由党候选人是詹姆斯·哈里斯·桑德斯。奥尔索普以536票（23.1%）的多数获胜。汤顿是保守党稳固选区，自由党原本考虑不参选，后来决定参选，以促使公众讨论爱尔兰自治问题。

en.s: The Battle of Caldera Bay, or the Sinking of the Blanco Encalada, was an engagement fought in the port of Caldera Bay during the 1891 Chilean Civil War between Balmacedist and Congressional naval forces on 23 April 1891. It involved two Balmacedist torpedo boats, Almirante Lynch and Almirante Condell, and the Congressional armored frigate Blanco Encalada. After both torpedoes from Almirante Condell had missed, Blanco Encalada was hit by a torpedo from Almirante Lynch and sank in minutes, with the loss of 182 men. The loss of Blanco Encalada hindered the Congressional forces, but they ultimately defeated the Balmacedist forces that August.

zh.s: 卡尔德拉湾海战又称“布兰科·恩卡拉达号沉没事件”，是1891年智利内战期间，巴尔马塞达派与国会派海军于4月23日在卡尔德拉湾港口发生的一场交战。巴尔马塞达派出动两艘鱼雷艇“阿尔米兰特·林奇号”和“阿尔米兰特·康德尔号”，攻击国会派装甲护卫舰“布兰科·恩卡拉达号”。康德尔号发射的两枚鱼雷均未命中，林奇号发射的鱼雷击中目标，布兰科·恩卡拉达号几分钟内沉没，182人丧生。该舰损失削弱了国会派，但他们最终于当年8月击败巴尔马塞达派。

en.s: The Battle of Quingua was fought on April 23, 1899, in Quingua — now Plaridel, Bulacan, Philippines, during the Philippine-American War (1899-1902). The engagement was a two-part battle that started general Elwell S. Otis' Bulacan and Pampanga offensive a day early. The first phase was a brief victory for the young Filipino general Gregorio del Pilar when he stopped the advance of the American Cavalry led by Major J. Franklin Bell. In the second phase of the battle, Bell was reinforced by the 1st Nebraskan Infantry who routed the Filipinos, but not before they repelled a cavalry charge that killed Colonel John M.

zh.s: 1899年4月23日，美菲战争期间，双方在金瓜（今菲律宾布拉干省普拉里德尔）交战。这场两阶段战斗使美军将领奥蒂斯原定的布拉干与邦板牙攻势提前一天开始。首阶段，菲律宾将领格雷戈里奥·德尔皮拉尔挡住了贝尔少校率领的美军骑兵；第二阶段，美军获得内布拉斯加第1步兵团增援并击溃菲律宾军队，但在此之前其骑兵冲锋遭击退，约翰·M·斯托岑伯格上校阵亡。

Each team progressed through four rounds to reach the final.

en.s: The 1909 Benavente earthquake occurred on 23 April at 17:39 GMT with an epicenter in the Lisbon region of Portugal. The earthquake had an estimated moment magnitude of 6.0 and had maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent). Beneath the Lower Tagus Valley, where the earthquake occurred, is a system of normal faults that were reactivated during the Eocene as reverse faults.

en.s: The 1927 FA Cup Final was an association football match between Cardiff City and Arsenal on 23 April 1927 at the original Wembley Stadium (then called Empire Stadium). The showpiece match of English football's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (better known as the FA Cup), it was the first such final to be broadcast on the radio. The victory by Cardiff marked the only occasion in the history of the tournament that the trophy had been won by a team outside England; the Cup had previously been referred to in the press as the "English Cup".

zh.s: 1927年英格兰足总杯决赛于1927年4月23日在原温布利球场（当时称帝国体育场）举行，由卡迪夫城对阵阿森纳。这场比赛是英格兰主要杯赛足总杯的决赛，也是首场通过电台直播的足总杯决赛。卡迪夫城获胜，成为足总杯历史上唯一一支在英格兰以外赢得奖杯的球队；此前媒体曾把这项赛事称为“英格兰杯”。

en.s: The Rhythm Club fire (or The Natchez Dance Hall Holocaust) was a fire in Natchez, Mississippi, United States on the night of April 23, 1940 that killed 209 people and severely injured many others. Hundreds of people became trapped inside the one-story steel-clad wooden building. The victims were mostly African Americans. The dance hall, which was a converted blacksmith shop once used as a church, was located in a one-story frame building at 1 St. Catherine Street, blocks from the city's business district. At the time, this was the second most deadly building fire in the history of the nation.

zh.s: 节奏俱乐部火灾又称纳奇兹舞厅惨案，于1940年4月23日晚在美国密西西比州纳奇兹发生，造成209人死亡、多人重伤。数百人被困在一层高的木制建筑内，建筑外覆钢板，死者大多是非裔美国人。舞厅所在建筑原是一家铁匠铺，后来改作教堂，位于圣凯瑟琳街1号，距市中心商业区几个街区。当时，这是美国历史上死亡人数第二多的建筑火灾。
